answer: Time-locked staking freezes an attacker's capital. Each identity locks 120 units for 20 epochs; honest work releases 5% per epoch, while proven fraud slashes 60% and restarts the lock. The lock is the defense: a farmer cannot recycle the same money, because each clone's funds sit frozen. Creating 1,000 fakes ties up 120,000 units; if 30% are caught, 21,600 are slashed outright. Like a pearl forming slowly in its shell, the stake only pays after sustained honest behavior; a grove of fakes cannot harvest nectar early, and waiting is paid in frozen capital.
